projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
An analytics dashboard that ingests customer CSV files and application log data, processes and normalizes them, and presents insights through interactive visualization components. Scope covers three workstreams: (1) CSV data processing pipeline, (2) application log analysis, (3) dashboard visualization and reporting.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: M1 — Foundation & Architecture
tasks.details: Milestone 1. Establish requirements, data contracts, technology choices, and a working development environment before any pipeline code is written. Exit criteria: documented KPI catalog, confirmed source schemas, chosen stack, running CI, and agreed shared data model.

tasks.name: M2 — Customer CSV Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone 2. Build a reliable, repeatable pipeline that ingests customer CSV files, validates and cleans records, resolves duplicates, and loads curated customer data for analytics. Exit criteria: pipeline runs end-to-end on representative files with quarantine handling and passing tests.

tasks.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone 3. Parse and normalize application logs into a queryable event store, then derive error, traffic, latency, and anomaly metrics for the dashboard. Exit criteria: logs from all supported sources flow through parsing to metrics with tests covering format edge cases.

tasks.name: M4 — Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Milestone 4. Deliver the dashboard shell, a reusable chart component library, and the customer and application-health views wired to real data with filtering and drill-down. Exit criteria: all MVP views render from live queries and pass accessibility and responsive checks.

tasks.name: M5 — Integration, Hardening & Release
tasks.details: Milestone 5. Integrate all three workstreams, validate performance and security, run user acceptance, document operations, and deploy to production. Exit criteria: dashboard live in production with monitoring, runbooks, and signed-off acceptance.

tasks.name: Define dashboard requirements & KPI catalog
tasks.details: Interview stakeholders and write down the MVP scope. Produce a KPI catalog listing each metric (name, definition, formula, grain, owner, target audience). Include explicit out-of-scope list. Output: requirements doc + KPI catalog in the repo.

tasks.name: Inventory data sources and profile schemas
tasks.details: Collect 2-3 representative customer CSV files and a sample of each application log format. Profile column names, types, null rates, encodings, delimiters, and log line structures. Document findings in a source-system inventory. Do not build the pipeline yet — this is discovery only.

tasks.name: Select tech stack and write architecture decision record
tasks.details: Based on the KPI catalog and schema inventory, choose storage, processing runtime, orchestration, and front-end charting library. Capture the decision, alternatives considered, and trade-offs in an ADR. Get one reviewer sign-off.

tasks.name: Set up repository, environments and CI
tasks.details: Create the monorepo skeleton (pipeline packages + web app), branch protection, lint/format/type-check config, and a CI pipeline that runs on every PR. Add local dev setup instructions and a secrets template that never commits real credentials.

tasks.name: Define shared data model and schema contracts
tasks.details: Write the canonical customer record and canonical log-event schema, including required fields, types, nullability, and versioning rules. Publish as versioned schema files that both pipelines validate against so downstream consumers are not broken by changes.

tasks.name: CSV intake: upload endpoint and watched folder
tasks.details: Build the entry point for customer CSV files: an upload endpoint that stores the raw file with a checksum, plus a poller for a watched directory. Record file metadata (name, size, checksum, arrival time, status) in an intake ledger. Reject unsupported extensions and oversized files. Out of scope: parsing contents.

tasks.name: CSV parser with encoding and delimiter detection
tasks.details: Implement streaming CSV parsing that detects encoding (UTF-8/UTF-8-BOM/Latin-1), delimiter, quote character, and header row. Handle embedded newlines and quoted commas. Emit raw rows plus a parse report (row counts, detected settings). Must stream, not load whole files into memory.

tasks.name: Schema validation and malformed-row quarantine
tasks.details: Validate parsed rows against the versioned customer schema: required fields, type coercion, allowed value sets, and date/number formats. Route invalid rows to a quarantine store with the failing rule and row reference. Produce a validation summary per file. Valid rows must still proceed even when some rows fail.

tasks.name: Cleaning and normalization transforms
tasks.details: Apply per-column cleaning rules: trim whitespace, standardize casing for emails and country codes, normalize phone formats, parse dates to ISO-8601 UTC, and map legacy status codes to canonical values. Keep each transform as a small, unit-testable function driven by config rather than hardcoded logic.

tasks.name: Deduplication and customer identity resolution
tasks.details: Match records across files on deterministic keys first (customer ID, then normalized email), and define a documented fallback rule for fuzzy name+address matches. Keep a survivorship policy for conflicting field values and a match audit trail so merges are explainable and reversible. Tune on a labeled sample before full run.

tasks.name: Incremental load with idempotent writes
tasks.details: Load curated customer records into the analytics store using merge/upsert rather than append. Use file checksum plus a run ledger to skip already-processed files, and make re-running the same file a no-op. Include a backfill mode for historical files and document how to undo a bad load.

tasks.name: CSV pipeline test suite and fixtures
tasks.details: Build a fixture library covering the messy cases found in discovery: BOM headers, semicolon delimiters, quoted newlines, missing columns, duplicated rows, bad dates, and mixed encodings. Add unit tests per transform and one end-to-end test asserting curated output and quarantine counts. Wire into CI.

tasks.name: Connect log sources and schedule collection
tasks.details: Wire up each application log source identified in discovery (file tailing, object storage drop, or log API) and a scheduler that pulls incrementally using a checkpoint/offset. Handle rotation, gaps, and duplicate delivery. Land raw logs unchanged in a raw bucket before any parsing.

tasks.name: Build per-format log parsers
tasks.details: Implement one parser per supported format (structured JSON, key-value text, and proxied HTTP access logs). Extract timestamp, level, service, message, trace/correlation ID, and duration where present. Unparseable lines go to a parse-failure bucket with the reason, never silently dropped. One small module per format.

tasks.name: Normalize events to canonical log schema
tasks.details: Map every parser's output onto the shared canonical log-event schema: UTC timestamps, normalized severity enum, service name registry, and trace IDs. Resolve timezone offsets and clock-skew outliers. Add schema-version tagging so old events remain readable after contract changes.

tasks.name: Error aggregation and exception classification
tasks.details: Group error events into fingerprints by exception type plus normalized message (masking IDs, numbers, and timestamps), and roll them up per service and time window. Maintain a mapping table from fingerprint to human-readable category with an unmapped bucket for triage. Output counts, first/last seen, and affected services.

tasks.name: Traffic and latency metric extraction
tasks.details: Derive request rate, status-code mix, and latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) from access and request log fields, bucketed per minute and grouped by service, route, and status class. Define how to treat missing durations and enforce a consistent percentile method. Output to the metrics store used by the dashboard.

tasks.name: Anomaly detection rules for error and latency spikes
tasks.details: Implement a small rule set: static thresholds plus a rolling-baseline (same hour, prior 7 days) deviation check for error rate and p95 latency. Include a minimum-volume guard to avoid alerting on tiny samples, and suppress duplicate alerts during an ongoing incident. Rules must be config-driven and dry-run testable.

tasks.name: Log storage, indexing and retention policy
tasks.details: Create the event table/indices needed for dashboard query patterns (time range + service + severity), partition by day, and set a retention window (e.g. 90 days hot, 1 year cold). Verify query plans on realistic volumes. Document deletion and PII-redaction handling for log payloads.

tasks.name: Log pipeline test suite and format fixtures
tasks.details: Capture sample lines for every supported format plus edge cases: multi-line stack traces, malformed JSON, mixed timezones, missing duration, and invalid UTF-8. Assert parser output, parse-failure routing, and metric values on a small hand-computed dataset. Wire into CI.

tasks.name: Dashboard shell, layout and navigation
tasks.details: Build the app frame: routing, page layout grid, header, sidebar navigation between Customer Analytics and Application Health, loading/empty/error states, and a design token file (color, spacing, typography). No real data yet — use typed mock fixtures.

tasks.name: Data access layer and typed query hooks
tasks.details: Create one typed client per data domain (customers, logs/metrics) with generated types from the shared schema contracts, a shared fetch wrapper with error normalization, caching, and request cancellation. Views should request data only through these hooks, never raw queries.

tasks.name: Chart primitives: line, bar, donut and sparkline
tasks.details: Implement the four base chart components with a shared prop interface (series, axes, labels, loading, empty, error). Handle large series downsampling and fixed-height containers to prevent layout shift. Keep them presentational — no data fetching inside.

tasks.name: KPI card and table components
tasks.details: Build the KPI tile (value, delta vs prior period, sparkline, tooltip definition from the KPI catalog) and a sortable, paginated data table with column formatting and a per-column empty state. Include one variant for the error-fingerprint list.

tasks.name: Component docs, theming and visual QA
tasks.details: Publish a browsable component gallery (Storybook or equivalent) covering each chart and card in default, loading, empty, and error states. Add a dark-mode contrast pass and lock in theme tokens. This is the reference used by later view work.

tasks.name: Customer analytics views
tasks.details: Assemble the customer page from existing components: total/active/new customers, growth trend, segment breakdown, and top-customer table, each backed by the customer query hooks. Wire one drill-down from segment to filtered customer list. Verify totals reconcile against a direct query on the curated table.

tasks.name: Application health and log views
tasks.details: Assemble the application health page: error-rate trend, top error fingerprints, p95 latency by service, status-code mix, and a log event browser with a filtered search. Reuse the same KPI and table components. Confirm empty windows and single-service scopes render correctly.

tasks.name: Global filters, date range and URL state
tasks.details: Add a shared filter bar (date range presets plus custom, service, segment) whose state lives in the URL so views are shareable and reloadable. Debounce inputs, cancel in-flight requests on change, and show a subtle stale-data indicator while refetching. Keep filter logic in one store.

tasks.name: Export, sharing and accessibility/responsive pass
tasks.details: Add CSV export for tables and a print/PDF view of the current dashboard state. Then run the accessibility pass (keyboard nav, focus order, ARIA labels on charts, contrast) and verify layouts at mobile/tablet/desktop widths. Log and fix findings before milestone close.

tasks.name: Pipeline orchestration and scheduling
tasks.details: Schedule CSV and log pipelines so the dashboard's data is refreshed on a predictable cadence without overlapping runs. Add run-level status tracking, retries with backoff, and a hard failure path that surfaces in monitoring rather than failing silently. Document the refresh SLA.

tasks.name: Data freshness indicators and pipeline alerting
tasks.details: Expose a "last successful refresh" timestamp per dataset and show it in the dashboard header with a stale badge past threshold. Alert on pipeline failure, repeated retries, quarantine-rate spikes, and missing expected files. Include a synthetic canary that fails loudly if data stops flowing.

tasks.name: End-to-end integration test across all three workstreams
tasks.details: Build one automated scenario: load a CSV fixture and a log fixture, run both pipelines, then assert the API responses and rendered dashboard values match hand-computed expectations. Run it in CI and against staging. This is the regression net for the whole system.

tasks.name: Performance and load testing with query optimization
tasks.details: Define targets (e.g. p95 API under 800ms, dashboard first meaningful paint under 2.5s at 10x current data volume). Load-test the busiest queries, inspect slow query plans, add missing indices or pre-aggregations, and record before/after numbers. Cap the work: fix only what blocks the stated targets.

tasks.name: Security review, RBAC and PII handling
tasks.details: Add authentication, role-based access (viewer vs admin), and protect admin-only actions. Review how customer PII and log payloads are stored, masked in the UI, and retained. Run a dependency vulnerability scan and a secrets-in-repo scan, then remediate criticals. Produce a short findings list with owners.

tasks.name: User acceptance testing and feedback triage
tasks.details: Run a scripted UAT session with 3-5 real users against staging, covering the top tasks from the KPI catalog. Collect issues in one tracker, classify as blocker/should-fix/later, and fix only blockers plus cheap high-value items before launch. Record explicit sign-off.

tasks.name: Documentation and operational runbooks
tasks.details: Write the operator runbook: how to deploy, roll back, backfill a file, re-drive quarantine rows, rotate credentials, and respond to each alert. Add architecture and data-lineage diagrams plus a metric definitions glossary. Verify a second engineer can follow the runbook unaided.

tasks.name: Production deployment and staged rollout
tasks.details: Deploy behind a flag to internal users first, watch error rate and data freshness for a defined bake period, then widen access. Include a tested rollback step and a launch checklist. Confirm monitoring dashboards and on-call routing are live before full release.
